summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 (no code changed — audit only)  **What I checked (read-only):** client `WatchlistPage.tsx`, `client/src/lib/api.ts`, `useAuth.tsx`, `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` + `schema.ts`, `modules/auth/handlers.ts`, `db/auth.ts`, `db/index.ts`, `App.tsx` routing.  **What I found:** The obvious suspects named in the ticket (client-side fallback to local/anonymous storage, missing session check, wrong default watchlist_id) don't appear to exist in the current code. Specifically: - All watchlist routes require a valid `arca_session` cookie and scope every query by the real `user_id`
